items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: He was that Toscannini out in front of a jazz orchestra.

ctx.x: It didn’t necessarily have to swing for Stan.
You know what? And he did present, as a front man it was priceless. He was that Toscannini out in front of a jazz orchestra.
He was a great front man.
